detail.title: Aura Smart Body Fat Scale with Bluetooth - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Aura is a Bluetooth-enabled body fat scale built around 4 advanced G-sensors for accurate readings up to a 180kg capacity, tracking weight, BMI, muscle mass and overall body composition. A step-on activated LED display turns on automatically and shuts off after use to conserve battery, keeping things simple and low-maintenance day to day. It works with iOS 7.0+ and Android 4.3+ devices, syncing measurements to a companion app for tracking body composition trends over time. Its compact, sleek build with a modern tech-pattern glass top suits bathrooms, home gyms or travel use, and it comes with 2 AAA batteries included for immediate out-of-box use.
